reviewer: independent read-only subagent (Explore type, fresh context, opus), one per tool; ran the tool's unit tests and read the tool, harness, fixtures and keys

findings.finding: The answer key can be read from every work folder (keys, make_acc.py, acc.mjs DEMO_GOLD, jev-src demo gold.json are a few levels up; the A forbid regex does not match them).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: work folders moved to <home>\AppData\Local\Temp\rw (keys, harness, the JEV copy with demo gold files and the case generators stay under the scratchpad); the wrappers import a JEV copy without gold.json/run outputs/tests; the forbid check now runs on BOTH arms and also matches scratchpad, keys, hidden_test, make_*, gold.json, harness. Folders of the other arm remain reachable by path: a residual caveat listed in the manifest deviations.

findings.finding: Arm A can read arm B's tool output in sibling folders and arm B is never checked for forbidden reads (forbid only ran over A).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: work folders moved to <home>\AppData\Local\Temp\rw (keys, harness, the JEV copy with demo gold files and the case generators stay under the scratchpad); the wrappers import a JEV copy without gold.json/run outputs/tests; the forbid check now runs on BOTH arms and also matches scratchpad, keys, hidden_test, make_*, gold.json, harness. Folders of the other arm remain reachable by path: a residual caveat listed in the manifest deviations.

findings.finding: Smoke-run leftovers (.tool-output, a log line) would contaminate acc-02-cart.B.r1.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: all work folders, prompts and logs were rebuilt after the smoke runs; the log is removed per B run at make time.

findings.finding: Gold of acc-03 AC-02 ("any other type rejected") is ambiguous with one non-allowed type tested.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: key now accepts Covered or Partial.

findings.finding: acc-01 AC-03b has a failing test (digit rule not enforced) while the key says Covered; agents that run pytest may downgrade it.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: the prompt now says to judge what tests assert, not whether they pass.

findings.finding: acc-04 AC-05 is borderline (removal asserted, re-booking not).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: key accepts Partial or Covered.

findings.finding: "Do not change any file" conflicts with the tool writing .tool-output in arm B.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: prompt says "Do not change any project file".

findings.finding: Grader exact-match on the verdict word, tests field unchecked.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: verdict word is case-normalised; the cited tests are recorded but not scored (kept as is, said in design.md).

findings.finding: All-criteria-right pass rule over few cases is coarse.
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: criteria right and false-Covered are reported next to pass/fail in every observedOutcome and in the report notes.

findings.finding: Forbid failure produced null instead of stopping; the Python path names the JEV venv (a breadcrumb).
findings.resolution: fixed before the runs: make() with --arm A only rebuilds the A folders and no longer deletes the B log; a failing forbid check now stops collect instead of recording null. The Python path stays (no other Python 3 is installed); it is the same in both arms.
